failures.description: The wrapper used zoom instead of the existing extent helper metadata field target_zoom. The partial directory and log are retained; a corrected wrapper reproduced all outputs in a new directory. No Wine input, helper implementation or observation was changed or retried.

limitations: Source descriptor kinds 1/2 are isolated in unchanged in-page gray/RGB controls. Exact type-2 frames still require target-scale extent changes; this is not a geometry-preserving production correction.
Signed endpoint hypotheses change physical extents and sometimes affine origins. Independent source declarations admit recovered integer coordinates; screenshot pixels are not used to fit them.
All nonnegative cells are exact after the declared signed-grid corrections, but negative-coordinate residuals and actual-page regressions reject a universal floor/truncation/origin-carry rule.

Decoded-pixel cropping has no zoom input and preserves visible mathematical support, but rounding the source-pixel window changes the sampled field. It is not presumed content-equivalent or a viewer implementation claim.
Actual evidence covers only pages 1, 5 and 10 of one pinned source at three zooms. This is not a new 77-page cohort or runtime parity sweep.
No production correction, new runtime dependency, API change, merge or release is included. Original font programs are unchanged. #543/#541/#406 remain open.
